scope: Bounded closure-throughput repair only: preserve catalog acceptance and all existing product gates while allowing stricter Work Order refinement predicates, fan out read-only post-freeze gates, fail forward when a preferred Verifier executor is unavailable, and make the existing MVP world/core control-drive branch-aware. No gameplay/runtime owner changes.
required_outputs: Focused regression tests for refinement/fan-out/fallback/branch-aware drive
Exact repair HEAD/TREE and CI evidence
stop_conditions: Any proposal to remove a catalog-required predicate or lower an acceptance threshold
Any new canonical owner or runtime gameplay change
Any relaxation of Implementer self-accept prohibition
Any change making independent review/verifier optional when the risk contract requires them
Any attempt to merge canonical main without a separate declared human merge gate
risk_reasons: Changes control semantics used to decide whether MVP evidence is sufficient
Must improve throughput without weakening checkpoint acceptance or role independence
notes: Human scope authorization is recorded in HA-V0-MVP-CLOSURE-THROUGHPUT-R1. This Work Order is control-only and does not replace V0-MVP-R1-WO-001. Parent MVP predicates and runtime candidate remain unchanged. Integration into canonical main remains a separate human gate. Initial Project Control run 34850223788 stopped before repair tests on pre-existing CANDIDATE_MAIN_DRIFT after canonical main advanced to 675c04bb213bbb68b8cdb500d540d57ce1490318. That drift is retained as a separate product-control item, not reclassified as a repair defect. Exact repair validation therefore uses the dedicated read-only harness-closure-throughput workflow, which does not authorize dispatch or acceptance.

design_brief.problem_statement: MVP leaf implementation completes much faster than closure because evidence/control gates are unnecessarily serialized or produce orchestration false negatives.
design_brief.current_behavior: A stronger Work Order predicate list fails an exact-equality Harness test; a preferred unavailable Verifier may stall the practical route despite fallback policy; world/core control-drive checks out exact SHA detached and fails branch-sensitive Drive; post-freeze read-only gates are not explicitly treated as a fan-out barrier.
design_brief.desired_behavior: Catalog predicates remain mandatory and ordered, Work Orders may add unique strengthening predicates, exact frozen product HEAD fans out independent read-only gates in parallel, unavailable preferred Verifier routes immediately to the next allowed fresh context, and control-drive uses the declared local branch at the same exact SHA.
design_brief.selected_design: Preserve all acceptance gates and change only orchestration semantics plus false-negative tests/workflow setup.
design_brief.why_selected: It reduces wall-clock closure latency and rework while keeping the same product evidence strength and ownership rules.
expected_risks: Accidentally permitting predicate removal instead of refinement
Confusing parallel read-only evidence with multiple runtime writers
validation_plan: Workflow text guard for branch-aware control-drive
Complete Harness regression in exact read-only validation workflow
Fresh Verifier consumes exact machine evidence
